cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageShelf
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageShelf can be used to store Typetray
This is a simple shelf box.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageShelf --x 120 --sy 60:80 --sh 40:60:80 --outside 1 --bottom_edge F --top_edge f --retainer 0 --thickness 6 --burn 0.2 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes StorageShelf --x --sy --sh --bottom_edge --top_edge --thickness --burn --reference --labels
